notes:
Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood. Started on Hosted API (quick POC) -> heavy interest in Dedicated/VPC for production because of compliance + data residency. Short timeline: want Dedicated in Q1 pilot, procurement in Dec.

POC & technical findings:
- 2024-09-20: Intro demo (Jordan + Priya) — basic chat + embeddings demo; product team impressed with latency profile; asked about batching and streaming.
- 2024-10-02: 2-week Hosted API POC kicked off (integration via SDK). Fireflies: FF-20241002-9a2b.
- 2024-10-16: POC results sync — avg inference latency ~140ms (satisfies UX), 95th pct at ~220ms for 512-token window; throughput requirement baseline = 50 rps sustained, spike to 150 rps during batch jobs.
- 2024-10-22: Pricing call — highlighted need for predictable unit economics; asked for reserved capacity pricing and overage model.
- 2024-10-28: Internal security questionnaire submitted (see Drive link). Redwood SE answered initial items; engineering follow-up requested.

Use-case and requirements (customer language):
- Primary: contextual support agent using RAG over product docs; secondary: similarity search for user journeys and automated summarization of session transcripts.
- Model preference: prefer vetted open models (LLM-70b class ok) but they want quantitative perf/latency profiles. Fallback routing desired to smaller quantized variant for cost-sensitive paths.
- Latency/throughput targets: p50 <120ms preferred for chat, p95 <300ms acceptable; throughput 50 rps baseline; burst handling to 150 rps.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high — will buy reserved Dedicated if unit economics justify it; wants clear deltas vs Hosted per-token costs.

Security & Compliance specifics (reason this is moving to Dedicated/VPC):
- Must have SOC2 Type II report and willingness to sign DPA with 1-year retention SLAs. "We can't risk customer PII leaking into a shared index" — CTO quote.
- SSO/SAML: Okta primary identity provider; require SSO for Console and scoped API keys provisioning flow integration.
- Audit logs: need immutable audit logs for admin actions and API key issuance with 365-day retention. Must be able to export logs to customer's SIEM (Splunk).
- Retention controls: ability to set retention per-namespace and ability to purge index data on request.
- KMS: customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) preferred for encryption-at-rest; HSM optional.
- Data residency: US-East preferred; EU for EU customers later.
- Network: VPC peering or PrivateLink; no public egress for customer data; ability to restrict egress to specified CIDR ranges.

Procurement & commercial notes:
- Estimated ARR target for contract: $75k–$250k/year depending on reserved capacity tier.
- Interested in 12-month reserved Dedicated with optional burst band. Wants SLA language for latency and uptime in contract.
- Legal requested sample DPA and SOC2 artifacts; they flagged indemnity and data processing clauses for redline.

Next steps (actionable):
1) Provide SOC2 Type II report and compliance pack (Jordan) — due EOD 2024-11-04.
2) Send Dedicated pricing deck with reserved tiers + overage calculus (Pricing team) — target 2024-11-06.
3) SE-led SAML test session with Okta sandbox (Priya) — schedule week of 2024-11-11.
4) Security deep-dive call with Infra/product security to validate KMS & audit-log export (ask: can export to Splunk/CloudWatch?) — target 11/8.
5) Legal exchange: send initial contract draft with DPA to BrightLoop legal; expect 2 rounds of redlines.

Open questions (from account):
- Can Redwood Dedicated support customer-managed KMS in the current GA? Time to enable?
- Can audit logs be configured per-tenant and shipped in near-real time to Splunk?
- Are there hard guarantees on the ability to purge embedded/index data within 24 hours on request?

Recent quotes from stakeholders:
- "We like Hosted for dev velocity, but for prod we need dedicated instances inside our VPC — cannot proceed without SOC2 and SAML." — VP Eng
- "Need clear math: if we commit to 12 months, what does unit price look like vs hosted?" — Head of Product

Internal notes for AE/SE:
- High confidence (70%) to close if SOC2 + KMS + SSO answered quickly. Decision driver is security artifacts + pricing transparency.
- Priya to prepare architecture sketch showing VPC peering + KMS key flow and audit-log export.
